description:
PRODUCTIVITY IS WEIRD AND IT HAS NOTHING TO DO WITH YOUR WORTH.

Why do you want to be productive?

Why do you want to achieve that thing that productivity will help you achieve?

Probably you just said something that had something to do with happiness/joy/fulfilment/purpose.

SO IF PRODUCTIVITY SHAME IS MAKING YOU UNHAPPY, CHANGE THE NARRATIVE.

If you want a hand building a relationship with productivity that SERVES YOU, rather than hurting you, that’s something I help people with.

I want to help you do the shit that you REALLY CARE ABOUT, that never seems to happen.

You can get in touch through my links, or just stick around, I’ll keep keeping here too.

.

#productivity #habits #capitalism #procrastination #adhd #perfectionism #selflove #joy
transcript: Next time someone tries to tell you it's normal to have to be productive, point out that their idea of productivity is to sit in a high-speed steel box every day so you can sit in a concrete box and tap on a glowing box that a stranger recruited you to tap on, and if you tap it well enough they give you digital numbers that you keep in your pocket but are stored in a different concrete box that you can then give to other people in exchange for permission to eat, be clean, be warm, and not worry too much about getting stabbed in the middle of the night. And apparently that makes more sense than catch fish, pick berries, cook, eat, swim, sleep. I'm going this way if you want to come.
